<translated_code>
import math
import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    x, y, n = map(float, data[:3])

    best_dif = 1e9
    best_a = 0.0
    best_b = 0.0

    for b in range(1, int(n) + 1):
        a1 = math.ceil(b * x / y)
        a2 = math.floor(b * x / y)
        # check a2
        dif = abs(x / y - a2 / b)
        if dif < best_dif:
            best_dif = dif
            best_a = a2
            best_b = b
        # check a1
        dif = abs(x / y - a1 / b)
        if dif < best_dif:
            best_dif = dif
            best_a = a1
            best_b = b

    print(f"{int(best_a)}/{int(best_b)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
